messages:
Sam: dropped a new mock and short doc about dynamic axis units + outlier gutters. idea: keep primary y-axis stable for short-term trends but show an "outlier gutter" to the right for extreme points so they don't crush the plot. figma: https://figma.redwood/axis-gutter
Priya: love the gutter idea. clarification: is gutter only visual, or does it change tooltips/aggregations?
Sam: visual-only by default. tooltip still shows true value and we add an explicit 'overflow' flag. backend can set overflow=true for points beyond clamp threshold.
Luca: implementation note: prefer auto-scaling modes: "Stable" (keep axis fixed by p95), "Adaptive" (rescale whole chart), and "Gutter" (stable + gutter). users can pin mode per-chart.
Tom: copy nit: 'Stable' is confusing. Suggest 'Fixed (trend view)' and 'Adaptive (show full range)'. 'Gutter' -> 'Overflow lane'.
Priya: agree on clearer copy. also for units: switch from K/M abbreviations to localized SI with tooltip full text, e.g., '12.3K (12,300)'. keyboard shortcut to toggle units is helpful.
Sam: about axis ticks: propose we always include a small secondary axis label that shows the full numeric format on hover to avoid truncation.
Luca: smoothing policy: for long time windows auto-smoothing ON, but with a prominent 'Raw' toggle. Default to raw for 1h and shorter.
Tom: accessibility: ContrastBot flagged that the overflow lane swatch uses a light gray that's <4.5 contrast at 14px labels. Need stronger stroke and a dashed pattern. Also ensure lane has aria-label 'overflow values clipped visually'.
ContrastBot: recommendation: use #2b2f31 on white for lane stroke, add 2px dashed pattern, include role=img description.
Priya: legends: when many series and collapsed legend, allow inline badges in series rows with text ellipsis and hover to reveal full name. Also allow filter-by-text in the flyout.
Luca: hover behavior: when a point is in gutter, show a small inline mini-histogram in tooltip showing where that point sits relative to recent distribution. Good for assessing whether overflow is a spike or trend.
Tom: perf: downsampling + overflow flags helps. backend can produce two streams: downsampled_buckets + outlier_list. front can draw buckets and overlay outliers. reduces payloads.
Sam: action items: Priya finalize copy variants and unit formatting table; Luca prototype overflow lane + mini-hist tooltip; Tom build API sketch for downsampled + outlier endpoints; ContrastBot will run color checks once prototype is up.
Priya: will post copy table and examples by Tue.
Luca: prototyping this afternoon, will add keyboard focus states.
Tom: API sketch by EOD tomorrow, include example response with "overflow": [ {point}]
Sam: thanks all. leaving numbered comments on figma for lane padding, legend flyout, and tooltip microcopy. ping here if blocked. :rocket:
